f70578ab7-3133-4ae9-86a1-4c226a809c5c.notes: Small blue medina name plate with raised letters on an ochre wall (Marrakech): 'the New Qissariya' (a covered market area). Spelled القسارية as on the plate (no ي after ق; not the standard spelling القيسارية). Arabic only, no French line. Paint worn and rust-streaked; source image is 1024 px.

f73613e0d-a4a6-4d96-a877-bf1ba1f5d4ea.notes: Restaurant facade in Marrakech: white 'McDonald's' letters with golden-arches M at upper left, golden arches in the centre, large Arabic 'ماكدونالدز' at upper right. A smaller Arabic repeat sits under the terrace railing. Distractor: blue Happy Meal promotional banner (French). People at the terrace and passers-by in the foreground are incidental.

f885bf476-cc2a-4e3e-810a-940bdc96570a.notes: Rusty hanging board with painted smiling lips, in a narrow medina lane (Essaouira). Not transcribed: the small bottom line with a phone number (GSM 06 10 74 ...) and the proprietor's name in Arabic, which are too small and rusty to read reliably. The sign gives a trade, not a proper name.

f8c55d3bd-b2bd-4692-8cac-151fd633d75d.notes: Hand-painted gym boards on a whitewashed wall (Tangier medina). Target is the name across the top of the right-hand board. The painted bodybuilders are illustrations, not real people; the supplement-tub labels (PROTEN, MASS+ 2000, weider 2000, MAS, PLUS, COMPLE...) are distractors.

f9091faf2-d014-43a4-b4c0-5173ae49a77a.reason: main legible sign is a Lavazza 'Espresso Point' brand panel; the café's own name (Royal / رويال, Pizzeria) is small, angled and cut off at the left edge, and the first Arabic word of the fascia is hidden behind the Lavazza panel

f920ba0e1-7ad3-40f9-911a-fcb52ecde62b.notes: Hand-painted yellow roadside board for an auto-electrician (Ouarzazate), with drawings of starter motors and arrows. 'ELECTRICITEAUTO' is painted without a space, as written. The two small handwritten 'ام الربيع' labels and 'A20' are the location the arrows point to (presumably a street or quarter named Oum Er-Rbia, unit A20); the business itself has no proper name. Sign is slightly angled.

f97833d93-b509-4dda-9244-eef45643122f.reason: no sign: upward view of medina balconies (Tangier)

f978720b1-8538-4752-8584-36453a3cd8ec.notes: Two white enamel plates on a crenellated gate monument at the Tizi n'Tichka pass (High Atlas). The plates are small in the 1024 px source: the Arabic line's letter shapes are clear but individual dots are soft; the final letter of the first word looks dotless (ى), checker please confirm. Distractors: red 'CAFE RESTAURANT TICHKA' board at left, 'N° 9' on the building behind.

f9f735569-86ec-4090-ae56-e3759088162f.reason: wrong country: 1910 Lewis Hine photo of a vaudeville theatre in Delaware, USA (Library of Congress); also a child is the subject

fd5938219-f7f7-4806-aa3b-a1ca8693bfc2.notes: Roadside distance sign, two white panels. Red graffiti 'S.K' under the Latin line is a distractor.

k236826581.notes: KartaView street view, Casablanca. Red letters on the fascia plus the name repeated in script on two awnings; spelled 'VEA' (not 'Via') on the sign. Distractors: '... Boutique / Pour Femmes' sign at left, house number 95, stop and no-entry signs.

k229704477.reason: main sign is a BMW X2 billboard (pure advert); hotel names (La Menara, Hotel Imilchil) and the Petrom price board are tiny

Only the fully visible parts are transcribed. Clock face below is a distractor.

k236499173.notes: Bank branch, Casablanca (KartaView). Target is the green BMCI blade sign with the stars-and-birds logo; the fascia repeats 'BMCI' at an angle with an Arabic line that is too faded to read. Distractors: no-parking signs, a 'Réservé aux convoyeurs de fonds' plate, parking signs, a cut-off '...oons / ...NDIAL' sign at left.

c185237431.notes: Money-transfer / exchange office, Casablanca; yellow fascia and logo cube with a 'Change' panel below (the mirrored 'Change' seen through the cube is a reflection, not a line). An Arabic word on the fascia is cut off at the right edge; partial Arabic shop signs at left and a red banner at bottom right are distractors; '50' painted on the wall.
